description: Particle contamination detected on 12 wafers during post-etch inspection in Fab 3 cleanroom. Yield drop of 8% observed on affected lots.
Calibration drift found on Metrology Tool M-22 during routine check; measurements were off by 0.3 microns for the past 5 days.
Work instruction WI-045 was found to be an outdated revision on the assembly line floor, missing the latest torque spec update.
Operator skipped a bake step during moisture sensitivity handling for Lot #4521, resulting in failed MSL test.
Incoming silicon wafers from Supplier B showed surface defects exceeding acceptance criteria in 3 of 10 sampled lots.
Final test station reported inconsistent pass/fail results for the same units when re-tested within 1 hour.
Moisture barrier bags for SSD units found to have seal integrity failures in a batch of 200 units.
Non-conforming material tag missing on quarantined lot #7788, risking accidental release to next process step.
Furnace temperature excursion recorded 4C above spec for 15 minutes during anneal process on Line 2.
Trace metal contamination found on wafer surface post-CMP, source traced to slurry batch #221.
Change order for firmware version 3.2 was not reflected in the traveler document used on the floor.
Operator used incorrect recipe parameters on photolithography step for Lot #4599, causing overlay misalignment.
Supplier certificate of analysis for chemical batch did not match actual concentration values upon internal verification.
Burn-in test chamber #4 showed temperature non-uniformity greater than 5C across the tray.
Labeling error found on 150 finished goods units; incorrect lot number printed on outer carton.
Customer return analysis revealed units shipped with known non-conforming die that should have been scrapped.
Ion implanter dose monitor failed calibration check, flagged during preventive maintenance.
Airborne particle count exceeded cleanroom class limit in Bay 7 for 2 hours due to HVAC filter fault.
Assembly technician bypassed ESD wrist strap check station, potentially exposing units to electrostatic damage.
Deviation approval for temporary process change was not signed by the required quality approver before implementation.
Supplier quality audit found missing calibration records for critical measurement equipment used on our parts.
Functional test yield dropped 6% overnight on Line B with no process changes logged.
Anti-static packaging material found to be out of spec resistance range in incoming inspection.
In-process inspection found die cracking on 4 wafers not flagged by automated optical inspection system.
Preventive maintenance on CVD chamber was overdue by 3 weeks, exceeding the maintenance interval defined in SOP.
Foreign material found embedded in wafer surface during final visual inspection, source unknown.
Training record for new operator on ESD handling procedure could not be located during internal audit.
Reflow oven profile deviated from approved recipe due to unauthorized parameter change by shift operator.
Supplier delivered chemical batch past its expiration date, discovered during incoming QC check.
Test escape identified after customer field return showed a defect not caught during final test.
Carton drop test failure observed for new packaging design during routine qualification testing.
Lot disposition record shows conflicting status between MES system and physical hold tag on material.
Wet bench chemical concentration sensor gave inconsistent readings across three consecutive shifts.
Cross-contamination suspected between two product lines sharing the same handling tray without proper cleaning.
Solder paste inspection step was skipped for an entire shift due to equipment downtime, units released without check.
Revision history for quality manual section 4.2 shows a gap with no record of the last approved change.
New supplier onboarding skipped the required quality system assessment prior to first shipment.
Test program version mismatch found between two test stations running supposedly identical test flows.
ESD shielding bag material changed by packaging vendor without notifying quality team for requalification.
Scrap material was found improperly stored with production inventory instead of quarantine area.
Calibration drift found on Metrology Tool M-22 during routine check; measurements were off by 0.3 microns for the past 10 days.
